content:
The first day of the hackathon on "LeanLang for Verified Autonomy" will have some introductory lectures by myself, @T V H Prathamesh and some others. There will be a livestream beginning at 2026-04-17T09:15:00+05:30.

Schedule

All times are Indian Standard Time (UTC+05:30)

  • 9:15 - 9:30 am - Welcome, (Prasenjit Dey, Senthil Kandasamy)
  • 9:30 - 10:15 am - Siddhartha Gadgil, Leaping into LeanLang I
  • 10:15 - 11:00 am - Prathamesh Turaga, Introduction to LeanLang I
  • 11:00 - 11:15 am - Tea/Coffee
  • 11:15 am - 12:00 pm -  Abhishek Kumar Singh, Trustworthy Parallel Computing for AI at Scale
  • 12:00 - 1245 pm - Siddhartha Gadgil, Leaping into LeanLang II
  • 12:45 - 2:00 pm - Lunch
  • 2:00 - 2:45 pm - Siddhartha Gadgil, Leaping into LeanLang III
  • 2:45 - 3:30 pm - Prathamesh Turaga, Introduction to LeanLang II
  • 3:30 - 3:45 pm - Tea/Coffee
  • 3:45 - 4:30 pm - Ashish Mishra, Refinement Types for Verification, Synthesis, and (now) Testing.
  • 4:30 - 5:15 pm - Siddhartha Gadgil, Leaping into LeanLang IV
  • 5:15 - 5:30 pm - Discussion
Given the nature of the event the talks will be focussed more on programming and proving programs than mathematics, with some metaprogramming.
